name: Terminus
description: Terminus is a Ruby/Hanami web server for managing TRMNL e-paper display devices on your own local network, providing a privacy-first BYOS alternative to the hosted Core server.

notes.text: The first user to register is automatically granted verified status and full system access.
Requires at least 2GB RAM for optimal performance with Ruby/Hanami application.
First install compiles Ruby 4.0 from source and may take 10-20 minutes. Do not close the console.
Uses GitHub tags for version detection (no GitHub releases published by upstream).
